quote.text: La mauvaise habitude de se régler sur l’opinion d’autrui est si profondément enracinée, que le plus naturel de tous les sentiments, la douleur, a aussi son affectation
quote.author: Seneca
quote.aiInsight:
• Parenthood
    • Recognize that relying too heavily on the judgments of others can undermine the authentic bond you build with your child. Trust your inner wisdom when making decisions that shape their character and growth.
    • Understand that even natural emotions, like the pain of difficulty in parenting, are often colored by external expectations; nurture an environment where genuine learning and growth come from honest reflection, not societal pressures.
  • Leadership
    • As a leader, it is vital to cultivate the strength to decide based on reason and conscience, rather than being swayed by the pervasive opinions of others. This integrity builds trust and clarity within your team.
    • Remember that even discomfort—whether in decision-making or receiving criticism—should be met with calm introspection. A wise leader transforms these experiences into opportunities for genuine growth and steadfast resolve.
  • Product Management
    • In product management, balancing feedback without becoming overly dependent on external opinions is essential. Use insights from stakeholders to inform your vision while staying true to the core values of your product.
    • Recognize that the natural process of experiencing setbacks or challenges can be distorted by subjective views. Embrace these moments as chances to refine your strategy with clear-headed analysis and a focus on what truly matters for the product’s success.
